category: scholarly metadata and citation-graph API and dataset downloads

free_tier.stated: Most endpoints answer without authentication, rate-limited to 1000 requests per second shared among all unauthenticated users and further throttled under heavy use; a free API key gives 1 request per second on all endpoints, slightly more for some users after a review
free_tier.notes: The keyless figure is one pool for every keyless caller, not a per-caller allowance: a keyless paper search on 2026-10-30 answered 429.

per_object_cap.stated: API: batch lookup 500 paper ids and up to 10 MB a call, relevance search up to 1,000 results, bulk search up to 1,000 papers a call and 10,000,000 in all; datasets: 30 partition files each (papers in 1.5GB files, citations in 8.5GB files)

retention.stated: the API is a live index; datasets are dated releases (latest 2026-10-27) with incremental diffs from one release to the next

egress.terms: Not metered by volume. Full dataset files are pre-signed S3 download URLs that the Datasets API hands only to a request with an API key; sample files are public.

interface_detail: REST at https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1 (key in an x-api-key header); the Datasets API at https://api.semanticscholar.org/datasets/v1 lists releases with no key and returns pre-signed S3 HTTPS URLs for each partition, and the diffs between releases, only with a key
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; the dataset partitions are fetched by walking the list of pre-signed URLs with any HTTP downloader
chaining: The datasets are the bulk path: release 2026-10-27 lists papers (200M records in 30 1.5GB files), citations (2.4B records in 30 8.5GB files) and s2orc_v2 full text (16M records in 30 6GB files), fetched with a key and kept current with diffs; the 1 request a second key covers lookups.

limits.value: no key: 1000 requests per second shared among all unauthenticated users, further throttled during heavy use
API key: 1 request per second on all endpoints; slightly higher for some users after a review
batch: 500 paper ids and 10 MB a call; relevance search: 1,000 results; bulk search: 1,000 papers a call and 10,000,000 in all, beyond which the Datasets API applies

binding_note: Keyless calls share one pool and the first one answered 429; a key gives a dedicated 1 request a second, and the full dataset downloads need that key too.

identity_cost.detail: Keyless calls are allowed. The key, which the full datasets also need, comes from a request form that asks for first and last name, an email (academic or corporate requested), an affiliation and its website URL, country, private or public use, a description of 50 words or more, the endpoints and the requests per day expected; the key is sent by email. No card. Whether every request is granted is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A keyless search on 2026-10-30 answered 429 on the first call; keys inactive for about 60 days or more may be removed, and the key form reports a backlog of requests.
confidence_note: The rate limits, key form and dataset sizes are vendor pages and API answers read on 2026-10-30; a keyless search answered 429 and a keyless dataset download listing answered 401. No key was requested, so the keyed rate and the time to issue a key are documented or unverified only.
